scenario.topic: Decide on the judging criteria for a student robotics competition

options.name: Performance-Focused Criteria
options.upside: Emphasizes measurable robot capabilities and task success.
options.concern: May undervalue creativity and teamwork aspects.

options.name: Balanced Criteria with Design and Innovation
options.upside: Provides a comprehensive evaluation covering multiple important aspects.
options.concern: More complex to score and requires diverse judging expertise.

options.name: Creativity and Teamwork Emphasis
options.upside: Encourages original ideas and collaboration among students.
options.concern: Less focus on objective performance metrics may affect fairness.

options.name: Simplified Performance and Reliability Criteria
options.upside: Easy to administer and clearly objective.
options.concern: Ignores design, innovation, and teamwork elements.

shared_context: A group of five participants must decide on the judging criteria for a student robotics competition. The criteria should fairly evaluate robot performance, design, innovation, and teamwork within the competition's scope.

personas.name: Maya
personas.background: Maya is a robotics mentor passionate about fostering creativity and teamwork among students.
personas.private_goal: To ensure the judging criteria highlight innovation and collaboration over just raw performance.

A.reason_for: Emphasizes measurable robot capabilities which are important for fairness.
A.reason_against: May undervalue creativity and teamwork, which are key to student growth.

B.reason_for: Provides a comprehensive evaluation covering multiple important aspects including teamwork and innovation.
B.reason_against: More complex to score and requires diverse judging expertise.

C.reason_for: Encourages original ideas and collaboration, aligning with my priority on creativity and teamwork.

D.reason_for: Easy to administer and clearly objective.
D.reason_against: Ignores design, innovation, and teamwork elements which I consider essential.

personas.name: Liam
personas.background: Liam is a competition organizer focused on efficiency and clear, objective judging.
personas.private_goal: To keep the judging process simple and objective to avoid disputes and delays.

A.reason_for: Emphasizes measurable robot capabilities and task success, which supports objective judging.
A.reason_against: May undervalue creativity and teamwork, but still manageable.

B.reason_for: Covers multiple important aspects, ensuring a fair and rounded evaluation.
B.reason_against: More complex to score and requires diverse judging expertise, which complicates administration.

C.reason_for: Encourages creativity and teamwork, which are valuable but less objective.
C.reason_against: Less focus on objective performance metrics may affect fairness and clarity.

D.reason_for: Easy to administer and clearly objective, minimizing judging disputes.

personas.name: Nina
personas.background: Nina is an engineering professor who values a balanced and thorough evaluation of student projects.
personas.private_goal: To ensure all critical aspects of robotics, including design and presentation, are fairly judged.

A.reason_for: Focuses on measurable performance which is important for fairness.
A.reason_against: May undervalue creativity, design, and teamwork, which are also important.

B.reason_for: Provides a comprehensive evaluation covering performance, design, innovation, teamwork, and presentation.

C.reason_for: Encourages creativity and teamwork, which are important for student development.
C.reason_against: Less focus on objective performance metrics may affect fairness.

D.reason_against: Ignores design, innovation, and teamwork elements, which I consider essential.

personas.name: Omar
personas.background: Omar is a former robotics competitor who prioritizes strong robot performance and reliability.
personas.private_goal: To highlight robot capabilities and consistent task success in judging criteria.

A.reason_for: Emphasizes measurable robot capabilities and task success, which aligns with my priorities.

B.reason_for: Covers multiple important aspects including performance and design.
B.reason_against: More complex and less focused on pure performance.

C.reason_for: Encourages creativity and teamwork, but less focus on objective performance.
C.reason_against: Less emphasis on measurable performance metrics.

D.reason_for: Easy to administer and clearly objective with focus on reliability and consistency.
D.reason_against: Ignores design, innovation, and teamwork elements.

personas.name: Zoe
personas.background: Zoe is a STEM educator who values a balanced approach to judging robotics competitions.
personas.private_goal: To ensure students are evaluated fairly across performance, design, and teamwork.

A.reason_for: Focus on measurable robot capabilities is important for fairness.

D.reason_against: Ignores design, innovation, and teamwork elements.
